title: Make mailbox session-link accessibility describe navigation and preserve keyboard marker access
outcome: Mailbox header session-name links announce their navigation behavior accurately, and supported keyboard users retain a discoverable route to message marker actions without changing session navigation or Open mailbox.
acceptance: Mailbox header session navigation is not announced as opening a menu when activation navigates; any contextual action hint accurately describes supported platform behavior.
Keyboard access to mailbox message marker actions is reviewed on supported platforms and preserved through the existing marker owner; meaningful coverage documents the chosen behavior.
